title: mncs-store persistence driver still lacks retained in-process MNCS session
summary: Profile 0.18 and mncs-embed provide retained in-process typed sessions, but mncs-store still routes each semantic batch through a fresh CLI experiment and JSON corpus. The remaining gap is consumer integration, not absence of all in-process execution support.
requiredBehavior: Use a retained in-process typed MNCS session or stable embedding boundary for store semantic calls, while retaining host code only for filesystem/process transport and explicit platform effects.

observation.summary: The current lifecycle round-trip passes, but the Engine still launches fresh mncs experiment subprocesses and serializes JSON for every semantic batch; mncs-embed's retained Session is not used by the store consumer.

reproduction.instructions: run tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_u32_roundtrip_close_reopen and inspect Engine.run/call_many in tests/store_phase1a.py

evidence.summary: Round-trip semantics pass; the test remains subprocess/JSON-bound and took 17m13s on the current debug toolchain.
The retained in-process typed session capability exists and passes its current embedding test.

workaround.description: mncs-store batches calls through the CLI and JSON corpus transport to amortize process and compile cost.
